Here's the rundown on Cartwheel's roles and permissions (cw-roles):

Cartwheel has three roles:

1. Shoppers – Can see and manage their own orders only.
2. Merchants – Can see and manage orders for their own store. They can't view other stores' orders or a shopper's purchases from other stores.
3. Support staff – Can look up any order on the platform.
